notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Croaking Counterpart
description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage that is a 1/1 Frog.
Repeat from step 3.
